# Kimodo motion-generation service dependencies.
#
# NOT installed from the vendored pyproject.toml: that pulls the interactive
# demo's stack (gradio, viser, trimesh, scenepic, av, boto3, mujoco) which this
# headless service never imports. `run_server` installs the vendored package
# with `--no-deps` and uses this list instead.
#
# torch is installed SEPARATELY by run_server, CUDA-matched via select_torch.py.

# PINNED, AND NOT SAFE TO BUMP.
# Kimodo's vendored LLM2Vec makes the Llama encoder bidirectional by overriding
# LlamaModel._update_causal_mask. From transformers ~5.2 onward LlamaModel.forward
# calls the module-level create_causal_mask() and never calls that override, so
# the override becomes dead code and the encoder silently runs CAUSALLY --
# producing plausible-but-wrong embeddings with no error. Symptom: motion that is
# merely mediocre. Verify bidirectionality before changing this pin.
transformers==5.1.0

peft>=0.18
hydra-core>=1.3
omegaconf>=2.3
einops>=0.7
numpy>=1.23
scipy>=1.10
safetensors
huggingface_hub
tqdm
packaging
pydantic>=2.0
filelock>=3.20.3

# BVH export (pulls PyGLM + SpatialTransform).
bvhio

# The service itself.
fastapi
uvicorn
requests
